name: CX Ontology
description: Closed-world CX ontology for the CXOS workspace: system-level, domain-specific taxonomies for the contact center stack (IVR, ACD, WFM, QA, CRM, KM, Speech Analytics, Outbound, VOC, CCaaS, CAI, WFO, Journey Orchestration, Fraud & Auth, Desktop Assist), aligned with the Coxswain engine ontology so model proposals stay inside a deterministic vocabulary.

categories.self_service: Automated systems that resolve or advance contacts without a live agent
categories.routing: Systems that assign, queue, and connect contacts to the right resource
categories.workforce: Systems that forecast, staff, and manage agent time
categories.quality: Systems that evaluate and improve interaction quality
categories.customer_data: Systems of record for customer context
categories.knowledge: Systems that supply answers to agents and customers
categories.analytics: Systems that extract meaning from interaction content
categories.outreach: Systems that initiate contact toward customers

interactionLifecycle.name: Arrival
interactionLifecycle.description: Contact enters on a channel; identity captured via ANI, login, or form

interactionLifecycle.name: Identify & Authenticate
interactionLifecycle.description: System matches customer to CRM record and applies authentication strength rules

interactionLifecycle.name: Self-Service
interactionLifecycle.description: IVR/automated channels attempt containment before queueing

interactionLifecycle.name: Queue
interactionLifecycle.description: Contact waits under ACD service-level rules; callback or overflow may apply

interactionLifecycle.name: Routing
interactionLifecycle.description: ACD selects resource by skills, priority, and availability

interactionLifecycle.name: Handling
interactionLifecycle.description: Agent (or bot) resolves using CRM context and KM answers; QA may sample later

interactionLifecycle.name: Wrap-Up
interactionLifecycle.description: After-contact work: disposition, CRM logging, follow-up tasks

interactionLifecycle.name: Resolution
interactionLifecycle.description: Customer need closed; FCR determined by downstream contact behavior

interactionLifecycle.name: Feedback
interactionLifecycle.description: VOC survey or listening post captures perception; results feed drivers analysis

values.synchronous: Real-time conversations: phone, chat, video, callback

values.automated: Resolved by machine: IVR, bot, notification broadcast
values.assisted: Human-held with system support: agent + KM/CRM
values.unattended: No live resource at delivery time: voicemail drops, automated sms
values.multi_agent_a2a: Coordinated across multiple autonomous and specialist agents via A2A protocol with human-in-the-loop escalation

journeyTriad.description: Three-plane closed-loop architecture unifying prescriptive design, empirical telemetry, and real-time intervention across customer journeys.

planes.name: Plane 1: Customer Journey Mapping (Prescriptive Blueprint)
planes.question: What do we HOPE will happen and plan for?

planes.name: Plane 2: Customer Journey Tracking & Process Mining (Empirical Reality)
planes.question: What DID actually happen across channels and agents?

planes.name: Plane 3: Real-Time Journey Orchestration (Active Intervention)
planes.question: What IS happening right now and what SHOULD happen next?

contextEnvelopeSpec.description: Canonical Omnichannel & A2A Context Envelope propagated across channel switches, bot-to-bot (A2A) delegations, and bot-to-human escalations.

taxonomies.name: Interactive Voice Response
taxonomies.summary: Voice self-service: menus, DTMF/ASR, transactions, containment

taxonomies.name: Automatic Call Distributor
taxonomies.summary: Queueing, skills-based routing, service level, transfers, overflow

taxonomies.name: Workforce Management
taxonomies.summary: Forecasting, scheduling, shrinkage, intraday adherence, occupancy

taxonomies.name: Quality Assurance
taxonomies.summary: Transaction evaluation, scorecards, calibration, auto-fail compliance items

taxonomies.name: Customer Relationship Management
taxonomies.summary: Customer context: record hierarchy, screen pops, consent states, data quality

taxonomies.name: Knowledge Management
taxonomies.summary: Curated answers: article lifecycle, agent assist, customer-facing help

taxonomies.name: Speech & Text Analytics
taxonomies.summary: Transcription, topics, sentiment, emotion, auto-disposition, compliance spotting

taxonomies.name: Outbound Dialer & Campaigns
taxonomies.summary: Dialing modes, campaign types, list management, regulatory controls

taxonomies.name: Voice of the Customer
taxonomies.summary: Surveys, listening posts, NPS/CSAT/CES instruments, close-the-loop

taxonomies.name: Contact Center as a Service & Telephony Fabric
taxonomies.summary: SIP trunks, SBC, WebRTC endpoints, media recording, carrier failover, region resilience

taxonomies.name: Conversational AI & Virtual Agents
taxonomies.summary: Intent NLU, slot filling, LLM RAG grounding, hallucination guardrails, containment handoff, turn latency

taxonomies.name: Workforce Optimization & Engagement
taxonomies.summary: Coaching workflows, gamification, skill progression matrices, agent attrition risk, desktop analytics

taxonomies.name: Real-Time Journey Orchestration & NBA
taxonomies.summary: Plane 3 (What IS/SHOULD happen): live state estimation, conformance-drift intervention, NBA arbitration, suppression, dynamic steering

taxonomies.name: Fraud Detection & Caller Authentication
taxonomies.summary: ANI spoofing detection, voice biometrics, KBA threat mitigation, step-up MFA, ATO prevention

taxonomies.name: Agent Desktop & Real-Time Co-Pilot
taxonomies.summary: Unified agent desktop, real-time call summarization, next-best-response cards, ACW automation, swivel-chair elimination

taxonomies.name: Omnichannel Orchestration & Context Sharing
taxonomies.summary: Cross-channel context envelopes, identity stitching, modality switching (web/app/chat/voice), SIP UUI & token hydration, warm handoff continuity

taxonomies.name: Agent-to-Agent (A2A) & Multi-Agent Facets
taxonomies.summary: Agent Cards, capability discovery, AI-to-AI task delegation, supervisor/specialist topologies, shared memory provenance, confidence-gated human handoff

taxonomies.name: Customer Journey Mapping (Prescriptive Blueprint)
taxonomies.summary: Plane 1 (What we HOPE & plan): Golden Path blueprints, persona JTBD stages, Moments of Truth, stage SLA budgets, planned fallback branches

taxonomies.name: Customer Journey Tracking & Process Mining
taxonomies.summary: Plane 2 (What DID happen): cross-channel event reconstruction, actual path discovery, planned-vs-actual conformance drift, loop & drop-off attribution
